messages:
elaine-sales: Hey team — POC kickoff with Acme tomorrow. They insist on HSM-backed, customer-managed keys for all inference workloads. Need quick alignment on what Redwood supports for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Who can take the KMS/HSM runbook?

sam-se: I can run the tech presales. Short summary: we support customer-managed keys via envelope encryption. Private supports PKCS#11 HSM or cloud KMS. Hosted uses a cross-account KMS grant + envelope wrap; Redwood never holds plaintext key material.

maria-customer: Our CISO (raj) requires FIPS-validated HSM, auditable rotations, and BYOK. We use AWS CloudHSM + AWS KMS.

raj-ciso: Need confirmation on: 1) HSM attestation / key origin 2) CloudTrail for every Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey 3) 90-day rotation with preserved provenance 4) proof Redwood cannot export unwrapped DEKs.

nina-sec: We can meet those. For Hosted: envelope model where customer CMK wraps tenant DEKs stored encrypted. We surface KMS request IDs in our logs. For Private: direct HSM integration and we can validate attestation during onboarding.

kevin-eng: Implementation notes: - We currently call GenerateDataKey then wrap; we can switch to GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + ReEncrypt if customer requires no plaintext ever returned. - For CloudHSM in Private: support PKCS#11 but need network routing and a KMS proxy component.

sam-se: Important: Hosted cannot accept direct HSM peering. Hosted customers must use cloud KMS grants. Dedicated/Private can attach to customer HSMs. Flag this in contract language.

maria-customer: How will rotation work with minimal downtime? Re-encrypting all DEKs at once could be expensive.

nina-sec: Two supported approaches: 1) Lazy rewrap (rewrap-on-access) — zero downtime, gradual; recommended for large stores. 2) Bulk rewrap job — immediate consistency but heavier. We'll include both in the runbook.

kevin-eng: We store metadata for each DEK: key_alias, wrap_version, kms_key_id, wrapped_key_blob. Rewrap only updates wrapped_key_blob and wrap_version; payloads are unaffected.

raj-ciso: Also need attestation artifacts and key origin proof. Can Redwood provide AWS KMS metadata and generation info?

nina-sec: Yes — for cloud KMS we can surface ARN, Origin (AWS_KMS/EXTERNAL), creation date, and keyState. For on-prem HSMs we require customer-supplied attestation statements; on Private we can capture them during onboarding.

sam-se: POC action items: 1) Send KMS integration doc template to Acme. 2) Demo envelope flow using GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext. 3) Security to map logs to customer SIEM (CloudTrail -> S3 -> SIEM). 4) Eng to outline rewrap cost/timeline.

elaine-sales: Assigning: sam to demo, kevin to draft rewrap playbook, nina to provide attestation checklist. I'll update Acme and loop raj. Need by EOD for kickoff deck.

kevin-eng: Note blocker: cross-account grants require customer to add our AWS principal to key policy; legal sometimes resists long-lived permissions. We can use time-bound grants and short-lived roles.

raj-ciso: Time-bound grants OK. Also require key usage restrictions (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey only), no ScheduleKeyDeletion.

nina-sec: We'll propose a minimal grant set and guardrails: kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:ReEncrypt*; cloudtrail audit; no ExportKeyMaterial.

sam-se: Include this grant snippet in the POC deck:
```
{
  "Sid": "RedwoodKmsAccess",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDDENW:role/redwood-kms-role"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:ReEncrypt*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

maria-customer: One last ask: ops runbook for compromise (revoke, rotation, replay prevention)?

nina-sec: Runbook outline: 1) disable/disable CMK 2) create new CMK and rewrap (bulk or lazy) 3) revoke old grants/roles 4) verify audit trails and CIEM alerts. We'll attach CLI steps for AWS and notes for CloudHSM.

deploy-bot: Attached: https://internal.redwood/docs/kms-hsm-integration — includes grant JSON, rewrap scripts, Private onboarding checklist.

elaine-sales: I'll share docs with Acme and schedule demo. Drop any last blockers here. :thumbsup:
